title: 2026 Claude Platform & API Updates
content:
## Overview

2026 brought a wave of developer-facing improvements to the Claude platform: a new command-line client, native AWS integration, richer diagnostics, doubled rate limits, and new product lines targeting design and small business. This page tracks the major platform changes from early 2026 through May 2026.

---

## ant CLI

Anthropic launched **ant**, a command-line client for the Claude API that complements (and integrates with) Claude Code. Key features:

- Faster, scriptable interaction with the Claude API from the terminal
- Native integration with Claude Code sessions
- **YAML-based versioning** of API resources — prompts, tools, and agent configurations can be stored and diffed like code
- Designed for developers who want to manage Claude API resources alongside their codebase in source control

The `ant` CLI is distinct from `claude` (Claude Code CLI): `ant` targets API resource management and scripting; `claude` targets interactive agentic coding sessions.

---

## Claude Platform on AWS

The Claude Platform is now available natively on AWS, bringing the full Claude API feature set to AWS customers without requiring a separate Anthropic account:

- **AWS authentication** — use IAM roles and existing AWS credentials
- **AWS billing** — usage billed through your AWS account, compatible with AWS commitment retirement (EDP)
- **Full feature parity** — managed agents, code execution, web tools, prompt caching, and new models all available
- **Data residency** — leverage existing AWS region selections for compliance requirements

This makes Claude a first-class option for enterprises already standardized on AWS infrastructure.

---

## Cache Diagnostics (Public Beta)

Debugging prompt cache misses has historically been opaque. The **cache diagnostics** feature, now in public beta, makes this transparent:

- Pass `diagnostics.previous_message_id` on a Messages API request
- The API response includes a `cache_miss_reason` field explaining exactly where the prompt cache prefix diverged from the previous turn
- Common reasons: content change, token boundary shift, model version mismatch

This is especially useful for agentic systems where prompt caching dramatically reduces costs, and unexpected cache misses can silently inflate API spend.

```json
{
  "diagnostics": {
    "previous_message_id": "msg_abc123"
  }
}
// Response includes:
// "cache_miss_reason": "content_changed_at_position_1204"
```

---

## Web Search Tool: SEC Filing Data

The built-in web search tool (available on the Claude API) now returns richer **SEC filing data**, including:
- Structured extraction from 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K filings
- Citation support — results include source links to EDGAR documents
- Useful for financial research agents, earnings analysis pipelines, and due-diligence workflows

---

## Rate Limit Increases

In response to developer demand at scale:
- **Claude Code rate limits doubled** — relevant for teams running many simultaneous agentic coding sessions
- **Claude Opus API limits raised** — making it practical to build production applications on the highest-capability model tier

---

## Claude Design (Anthropic Labs)

**Claude Design** is a new product from Anthropic Labs that lets users collaborate with Claude to produce visual outputs: designs, prototypes, slide decks, and one-pagers. It operates as a design co-pilot rather than a replacement for dedicated design tools — users describe what they want and iterate conversationally.

Available as a standalone product, separate from the main Claude.ai interface.

---

## Claude for Small Business

Anthropic launched **Claude for Small Business**, a product tier targeted at small business owners who want AI assistance without enterprise complexity:
- Simplified onboarding, no API knowledge required
- Pre-built workflows for common SMB use cases
- Pricing and support structured for smaller organizations

---

## Code with Claude 2026

Many of these announcements were made at **Code with Claude 2026**, Anthropic's developer conference held in San Francisco in early May 2026. The conference featured keynotes, breakout sessions, and workshops on building with Claude, and served as the launch event for Managed Agents capabilities, Claude Design, and the Claude for Small Business tier.
